tests.description: Timed check on Spirometer Trace Interpretation

questions.question: Calculate vital capacity given: TV = 500 ml, IRV = 3,000 ml, ERV = 1,200 ml.
questions.explanation: Answer: VC = TV + IRV + ERV = 500 + 3,000 + 1,200 = 4,700 ml.
